scope: School first Year 1 Pure Maths mock ONLY, crosswalk from v244 plus independently tested v252/v260 examples

rows.assessableSkill: Construct a complete unfamiliar divisibility proof by deduction
rows.remainingLimitation: Specific symbolic proof for integer divisibility; the answer matcher has only fixed examples, not arbitrary examiner-prose proofs.

rows.assessableSkill: Evaluate a proof by exhaustion with a fully stated finite domain
rows.remainingLimitation: Checks every value in the explicit finite domain; other finite domains or incomplete cases still need testing.

rows.assessableSkill: Represent transformation of specific graph coordinates under f(ax)
rows.remainingLimitation: Verified unfamiliar negative and combined argument transformations for selected points, not a full sketch of a curve.

rows.assessableSkill: Analyse intersections and tangent equations in unfamiliar circle questions
rows.remainingLimitation: Independent tangent/intersection examples with algebraic checks, not a graph-drawing marking sign-off.

rows.assessableSkill: Identify a specified coefficient from an unfamiliar positive integer binomial expansion
rows.remainingLimitation: A complete unfamiliar positive-integer binomial coefficient extraction, not fractional or Year 2 generalised binomial.

rows.assessableSkill: Evaluate an unfamiliar area between a curve and axis crossing its roots
rows.remainingLimitation: Area from 0 to 4 crossing the axis by integration and sign reversal, not arbitrary examiner drawn curves.

rows.assessableSkill: Deduce whether three given points are collinear using proportional 2D vectors
rows.remainingLimitation: Non-zero proportional position vectors for collinearity on specified coordinates, not all unseen vector proofs.

whatThisDoesNotProve: The 50 v244 audit skills are not claimed to exhaust every AQA first-year assessable bullet
The rest of the 43 core evidence rows have not been independently re-reviewed by this PR
A short flashcard answer is not a complete examiner marking rubric for a long proof
Graphs, freehand vector diagrams and real photographs remain manually reviewable
Generalised binomial, contradiction, numerical methods and Year 2 remain outside FIRST mock
No student mastery claim or AQA past-paper completeness claim
